chunks.text: Today we will talk about Romania.
Romania is a country with castles, forests, mountains and legends.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Romania?
Romania is in Eastern Europe.
It is next to Hungary, Serbia, Bulgaria, Ukraine and Moldova.
To the southeast, it touches the Black Sea.
What is the capital city of Romania?
The capital city is Bucharest.
It is the biggest city in Romania.
Bucharest has parks, museums, cafes and old buildings.
People call it Little Paris because of its style.
Other cities include Cluj -Napoca, a student in tech city.
Brasov near the mountains.
Timisoara, full of culture.
Sibiu and Ashi.
How many people live in Romania?
About 19 million people live in Romania.
Most people live in cities and towns, but some live in villages in the countryside.
What language do people speak in Romania?
The official language is Romanian.
It is a romance language, like Spanish and Italian.
Many people also speak English, French or Hungarian in some areas.
What is the weather like in Romania?
Romania has four seasons.
Hot summers, perfect for the beach.
Cold winters with snow in the mountains.
Mild springs with flowers and green trees.
Colorful autumns with red and yellow leaves.
It is a great place for skiing, hiking or sunbathing.
What does Romania look like?
Romania has the Carpathian Mountains, forests, rivers and lakes.
The Danube River and the Danube Delta.
Castles, churches and villages.
It is a country full of natural beauty and old traditions.
What animals live in Romania?
In Romania you can find bears, wolves and lynx in the forests, deer, foxes and wild boars, eagles, owls and storks, fish, frogs and otters in rivers and lakes.
The Carpathian Mountains are home to many wild animals.
What do people eat in Romania?
Romanian food is rich, warm and home cooked.
People eat bread, cheese and eggs.
Palenta, Mama Liga, cornmeal dish.
Soups and stews meet like pork, chicken and beef.
Vegetables like cabbage, potatoes and beans.
Popular dishes.
Sarmale, cabbage rolls with rice and meat.
Ciurba, sour soup with meat or vegetables.
Meat -to -tay, grilled minced meat rolls.
Kozenac, sweet bread with nuts or chocolate.
What do people drink in Romania?
People drink water and fruit juice, tea and coffee, milk and yogurt drinks.
Adults may drink wine, beer or tuica, a strong fruit spirit.
Romania is known for its local wines and plum brandy.
What is life like in Romania?
Life in Romania is a mix of modern and traditional.
People enjoy spending time with family, cooking and sharing food, listening to music and dancing, going to festivals and church, walking in parks or mountains.
In villages, life is quiet and close to nature.
What are some holidays and traditions?
National Day, December friend.
Easter with painted eggs and church services.
Christmas with carols and special food.
Marcy Shore, March 1st, a spring tradition with red and white strings.
Folk festivals with costumes, dances and music.
Traditional clothes are often colorful and handmade.
Some fun facts about Romania.
Romania is home to Dracula's legend and brand castle.
The Palace of the Parliament in Bucharest is one of the largest buildings in the world.
The Danube Delta is full of birds and nature.
The flag is blue, yellow and red.
Romania has one of the oldest languages in Europe still spoken today.
Now you know many things about Romania.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about the castles, the food and the traditions.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Amili.
See you next time.
Goodbye, or as they say in Romanian.
La de vedere.
